events.title: The Night Shift

events.title: Break-room meal log
events.summary: Mara and Leon shared a takeaway meal. Priya ate a meal from home and did not share their food. A day-shift colleague ate the same takeaway leftovers but reported no problem in this story.

events.title: Sealed maintenance report
events.summary: A fictional facilities inspection records a stuck heating-system exhaust damper and a failed exhaust connection adjoining the basement. The report attributes the room incident to that equipment fault, not to the meals.

events.title: Resolution decision accepted
events.summary: The maintenance report now directly records the heating/exhaust fault.
